entities.name: Aetherdrift
entities.description: A death-defying interplanar circuit race across Amonkhet, Avishkar and Muraganda whose champion wins the Aetherspark; it is also the name of the Magic set that tells the story.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who competes in the Ghirapur Grand Prix, hoping to finish first and win the Aetherspark for Nissa Revane.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker for whom Chandra hopes to win the Aetherspark.

entities.name: The Aetherspark
entities.description: The incredible prize given only to the champion of the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane across which the race is run.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane across which the race is run.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A plane across which the race is run; an existing location never before featured as a premier set.

entities.name: Guidelight Voyagers
entities.description: A racing team made fully of metal and animated by programming, rather than magic.

entities.name: Dragonstorm Arc
entities.description: The story arc of which Aetherdrift is the third set.

events.summary: Chandra Nalaar competes in the Ghirapur Grand Prix, a death-defying interplanar circuit race across Amonkhet, Avishkar and Muraganda, aiming to win the Aetherspark.
events.quote: Aetherdrift follows Chandra Nalaar as she competes in the Ghirapur Grand Prix , a death-defying interplanar circuit race across Amonkhet , Avishkar and Muraganda .

events.summary: The race is disturbed by sudden dragonstorms.
events.quote: The race is disturbed by sudden dragonstorms .

relations.note: Chandra hopes to win the Aetherspark for Nissa.
relations.quote: The story follows Chandra Nalaar , who hopes to finish first and win the Aetherspark for Nissa Revane .

relations.note: The set is the third in the arc.
relations.quote: The set is the third in the Dragonstorm Arc .
